summary: postinstall fetches and executes a binary from a bare-IP endpoint with TLS verification disabled
details: The package's npm postinstall hook downloads a platform tarball from a hardcoded bare-IP HTTPS endpoint (https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz) with certificate verification disabled (rejectUnauthorized:false), extracts it into node_modules via tar -xzf, chmods the contained binary to 0o755, and hardlinks it into bin/.onecode so the CLI launcher executes it. No hash or signature is verified. The destination is a raw IP address rather than a publisher-owned domain or CDN, and disabled TLS validation removes the only integrity check on the fetched executable. Any party positioned on the network path, or a change in control of that IP, can substitute arbitrary code that runs on the installer's machine as part of `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
